name: Sekhlo Schema Code
author: Mubashir Hassan

sections.description:
Sekhlo Schema Code is a powerful, all-in-one SEO and AI Search optimization tool for WordPress. It combines advanced Schema.org JSON-LD management with a state-of-the-art AI Search Visibility Monitor (Sekhlo AI Search) to ensure your content is perfectly indexed and understood by both traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and the next generation of AI-powered search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini).

Manage and inject multiple custom schemas per page, use our AI-powered generators to create complex markup, and monitor your site’s AI visibility score (AEO/GEO) in real-time. With integrated Header & Footer script injection, you can also manage tracking codes without touching a single line of theme code.

Key Features

🚀 Sekhlo AI Search (AEO/GEO Optimization)
* AI Search Visibility Monitor – See exactly how AI search engines interpret your content.
* AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) Score – Get a real-time score of how “AI-ready” your pages are.
* Direct AI Analysis – Connect your OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini keys for deep, personalized AI insights.
* GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) – Stay ahead of AI-driven search trends.

📋 Custom Multiple Schemas & Management
* Manage Multiple Schemas – Create and inject multiple JSON-LD schemas (e.g., Organization + WebPage + Article + FAQ) on a single page.
* Template Library – Over 30+ pre-built schema templates (Article, Product, FAQ, LocalBusiness, etc.).
* Visual Schema Editor – Easy-to-use interface to customize your structured data without coding.
* Bulk Actions – Quickly apply or remove schemas across multiple posts and pages.

📝 Headers & Footers Script Injection
* Insert code in Header (), Body (top of ), and Footer.
* Support for Google Analytics, Facebook Pixels, GTM, and more.
* Syntax-highlighted code editor for custom CSS and JS.
* No theme file editing required – scripts remain safe through theme updates.

🔍 Smart Analysis & Detection
* AI Content Detector – Analyzes your page content to recommend the most relevant Schema types.
* Conflict Detector – Automatically finds and flags schema conflicts from other SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, etc.).
* Real-time SEO Validation – Ensures your meta titles and descriptions are perfectly optimized for search and AI.

🎯 AI-Powered Prompt Generators
* AI Schema Generator – Generate complex JSON-LD markup instantly based on your page content.
* Meta Tags Optimizer – Generate high-CTR, AI-friendly titles, descriptions, and slugs.
* Internal Links Suggestor – Strategic internal linking ideas based on your sitemap.
sections.installation:
1. Search for “Sekhlo Schema Code” in the WordPress Plugin directory or visit https://wordpress.org/plugins/sekhlo-schema-code/ to download.
  2. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sekhlo-schema-code/ directory, or install through the WordPress ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to Settings > Sekhlo Schema to configure your API keys and global scripts.
  5. Edit any post or page to find the Sekhlo Schema Manager meta box for per-page optimization and multiple schema management.
  6. Use Sekhlo AI Search from the sidebar menu to monitor your site’s AI visibility.
sections.faq:
Does it support multiple schemas per page?

Yes! Unlike many other plugins, Sekhlo Schema Code allows you to create and manage multiple schemas on the same page, giving you full control over your structured data.

How do I monitor my AI Search visibility?

Navigate to the “Sekhlo AI Search” menu in your WordPress dashboard. You can run an analysis on any URL to see how AI engines perceive your site.

Does it work with Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes! It’s fully compatible. Use our Conflict Detector to ensure you’re not outputting duplicate schema.

Do I need an OpenAI key?

For core features, no. For advanced AI-powered analysis and recommendations, you can optionally connect your own API key in the settings.
